items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And, let's see, Pete Brown was working upstairs.

ctx.x: Back to Chicago. Where did you work with the Stuff Smith Trio? Do you remember the clubs?

Yeah. The Three Deuces, which was in the Loop, on Wabash Avenue, and the Garrick Lounge, which was on Randolph. And the Garrick Lounge was a very special kind of a place. It was an upstairs and a downstairs. I worked with Red Allen in the Garrick Lounge too. With Higginbottom (PHO1 ham NETC). Yeah, that group. Well, at that point Stuff wouldn't go to the Garrick Lounge, so Red Allen came to my house because he liked the way I played. I said, "Well, Stuff, if you're not going over to the Garrick, I'm going." And…
Nance was giggin around the Garrick Lounge or not, because he was still with Duke at that point.
